We kick off the New Year with a celebratory feast that embodies luxury and comfort. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Creamy Shrimp Cocktail: Fresh shrimp served in a homemade cocktail sauce, topped with a dollop of cream. 
1.2) Stuffed Mushrooms: Button mushrooms filled with a garlic herb cheese mixture, baked until golden. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Lobster Thermidor: Lobster meat cooked with egg yolks and brandy, served in its shell. 
2.2) Roasted Duck with Orange Sauce: Tender duck roasted to perfection, glazed with a citrusy orange sauce. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Garlic Mashed Potatoes: Creamy mashed potatoes enriched with roasted garlic. 
3.2) Glazed Carrots: Carrots cooked until tender and finished with a sweet glaze. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Chocolate Mousse: A rich, silky chocolate mousse topped with whipped cream. 
4.2) Tiramisu: Classic Italian dessert with layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cheese. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Fine Wines: A selection of red and white wines curated to complement the flavors of the meals. 
5.2) Champagne: Sparkling champagne to celebrate the new beginnings.

#*# Menu Week 2 (January 8th - January 14th): 
This week, we explore the flavors of the Mediterranean with a focus on fresh, vibrant ingredients. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Grilled Octopus: Tender octopus marinated in olive oil, lemon, and herbs, served with a side of pita bread. 
1.2) Caprese Salad: Fresh mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, basil, and balsamic glaze. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Grilled Lamb Chops: Succulent lamb chops seasoned with rosemary and garlic, served with a mint yogurt sauce. 
2.2) Sea Bass with Lemon Butter: Flaky sea bass fillets poached in a light lemon butter sauce. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Roasted Root Vegetables: A medley of carrots, parsnips, and turnips, roasted until caramelized. 
3.2) Greek Salad: A refreshing mix of cucumbers, tomatoes, red onions, olives, and feta cheese. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Baklava: Layers of phyllo dough filled with chopped nuts and sweetened with syrup. 
4.2) Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts: A simple yet delicious dessert with a touch of honey and crunchy walnuts. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Rosé Wine: A crisp, dry rosé to pair with the Mediterranean flavors. 
5.2) Ouzo: An anise-flavored spirit to enhance the taste of the seafood.

#*# Menu Week 3 (January 15th - January 21st): 
Our menu this week is inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Asia, offering a blend of bold and subtle flavors. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Spring Rolls: Crispy rice paper rolls filled with shredded vegetables and shrimp, served with a peanut dipping sauce. 
1.2) Edamame: Steamed soybeans seasoned with salt and served as a light snack. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Sichuan Beef: Thinly sliced beef stir-fried with Sichuan peppercorns and chili oil, served with a side of steamed broccoli. 
2.2) Thai Green Curry: Coconut milk-based curry with chicken, green chilies, and basil, served over jasmine rice. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Steamed Bok Choy: Fresh bok choy steamed and drizzled with sesame oil and soy sauce. 
3.2) Fried Rice: A hearty mix of cooked rice, peas, carrots, and scrambled eggs, garnished with scallions. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Mango Sticky Rice: Sweet sticky rice served with fresh mango slices and coconut milk. 
4.2) Green Tea Ice Cream: A refreshing ice cream made with high-quality green tea. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Jasmine Green Tea: A delicate green tea to complement the Asian flavors. 
5.2) Thai Iced Tea: A sweet and spicy black tea with condensed milk and lime.

#*# Menu Week 4 (January 22nd - January 28th): 
This week, we delve into the heart of American cuisine, focusing on comfort food classics. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Buffalo Wings: Crispy chicken wings coated in a spicy buffalo sauce, served with blue cheese dressing. 
1.2) Mac and Cheese: A creamy and indulgent macaroni and cheese with a crispy breadcrumb topping. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Prime Rib: Slow-roasted prime rib with a savory au jus, served with a side of roasted potatoes. 
2.2) Southern Fried Chicken: Juicy chicken pieces battered and fried to a golden brown, served with coleslaw. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Mashed Potatoes: Creamy mashed potatoes with a hint of garlic and chives. 
3.2) Cornbread: A moist and flavorful cornbread, perfect for soaking up gravy. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Pecan Pie: A rich and gooey pecan pie with a flaky crust. 
4.2) Apple Pie: A classic apple pie with a buttery crust and a generous filling of spiced apples. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Red Wine: A full-bodied red wine to pair with the hearty main courses. 
5.2) Sweet Tea: A refreshing sweet tea to complement the desserts.

#*# Menu Week 5 (January 29th - February 4th): 
Our menu this week takes us on a journey through the diverse flavors of Latin America. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Empanadas: Hand-stretched dough filled with beef, cheese, or vegetables, baked until golden. 
1.2) Plantains Fritters: Thick slices of plantain fried until crispy, served with a sweet and spicy dipping sauce. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Carnitas: Slow-cooked pork belly seasoned with spices and served with a side of refried beans. 
2.2) Peruvian Ceviche: Fresh fish marinated in lime juice, onions, and chili peppers, served with sweet potato and corn. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Black Beans and Rice: A hearty mix of black beans and white rice, seasoned with cumin and coriander. 
3.2) Avocado Salad: A refreshing salad of diced avocado, red onion, and cilantro, dressed with lime juice and olive oil. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Churros: Crispy fried dough sticks dusted with sugar and cinnamon, served with a side of hot chocolate. 
4.2) Dulce de Leche: A rich and caramel-like spread made from sweetened condensed milk. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Sangria: A fruity and refreshing sangria with a mix of red wine, fruits, and spices. 
5.2) Agua Fresca: A light and refreshing fruit drink, such as watermelon or pineapple.

#*# Menu Week 6 (February 5th - February 11th): 
This week, we celebrate the flavors of the Caribbean with a focus on tropical fruits and spices. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Jerk Chicken Wings: Spicy jerk-seasoned chicken wings grilled to perfection. 
1.2) Pineapple Salsa: A fresh and zesty salsa made with diced pineapple, jalapeño, and cilantro. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Jamaican Jerk Pork: Slow-cooked pork seasoned with jerk spices, served with a side of pickled onions. 
2.2) Trinidadian Roti: A flatbread stuffed with curried chickpeas and vegetables, served with a side of tamarind chutney. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Fried Plantains: Thick slices of plantain fried until crispy, served with a side of garlic aioli. 
3.2) Callaloo: A hearty green stew made with spinach, okra, and coconut milk, served with a side of rice and peas. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Coconut Sorbet: A light and refreshing coconut sorbet to cool down the palate. 
4.2) Rum Cake: A dense and moist cake soaked in rum, served with a side of whipped cream. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Rum Punch: A fruity and refreshing rum punch with a mix of fruits and spices. 
5.2) Mango Smoothie: A smooth and creamy mango smoothie with a hint of lime.

#*# Menu Week 7 (February 12th - February 18th): 
This week, we introduce our first Dessert Sunday, featuring a rich and decadent Chocolate Lava Cake. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Smoked Salmon Tartare: A vibrant and flavorful tartare made with smoked salmon, capers, and dill, served with a side of blinis. 
1.2) Goat Cheese Crostini: A crostini topped with creamy goat cheese, arugula, and a drizzle of balsamic reduction. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Grilled Salmon with Herb Butter: Flaky salmon fillets grilled to perfection, served with a side of sautéed asparagus. 
2.2) Beef Bourguignon: Slow-cooked beef braised in red wine with mushrooms and onions, served with a side of polenta. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Roasted Brussels Sprouts: Brussels sprouts roasted until tender and caramelized, served with a side of bacon. 
3.2) Garlic Mashed Potatoes: Creamy mashed potatoes enriched with roasted garlic. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Chocolate Lava Cake: A rich and decadent lava cake with a gooey chocolate center, served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. 
4.2) Raspberry Sorbet: A light and refreshing raspberry sorbet to balance the sweetness. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Pinot Noir: A light and fruity pinot noir to complement the flavors of the main courses. 
5.2) Sparkling Water: A refreshing sparkling water to cleanse the palate before dessert.

#*# Menu Week 8 (February 19th - February 25th): 
Our menu this week focuses on the vibrant flavors of the Middle East, with a particular emphasis on中东美食。 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Falafel: 炸至金黄的鹰嘴豆球，搭配新鲜的生菜、番茄和酸奶酱。 
1.2) Hummus: 用鹰嘴豆、橄榄油、柠檬汁和大蒜制成的经典鹰嘴豆泥，搭配薄饼和黄瓜条。 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Kebabs: 烤羊肉串或鸡肉串，搭配香料和蔬菜，佐以烤茄子和米饭。 
2.2) Shawarma: 薄片烤肉卷，搭配沙拉和酸奶酱，佐以薄饼。 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Tabouli: 用新鲜的菠菜、番茄、黄瓜和薄荷制成的清爽沙拉，佐以橄榄油和柠檬汁。 
3.2) Baba Ghanoush: 用烤茄子、橄榄油、柠檬汁和大蒜制成的美味蘸酱，搭配面包。 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Baklava: 层层酥皮夹着碎坚果，淋上糖浆，甜而不腻。 
4.2) Halva: 用芝麻、糖和香草制成的传统甜点，口感丰富。 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) Turkish Tea: 一种浓郁的土耳其红茶，带有独特的香气。 
5.2) Turkish Coffee: 一种浓郁的土耳其咖啡，带有细腻的泡沫。

#*# Menu Week 9 (March 4th - March 10th): 
This week marks the beginning of our Seafood Season Extravaganza, featuring a variety of fresh and sustainable seafood options. 
1. Appetizers: 
1.1) Shrimp Cocktail: Fresh shrimp served in a homemade cocktail sauce, garnished with a lemon wedge. 
1.2) Oyster Rockefeller: Oysters topped with a layer of spinach, mushrooms, and a creamy béchamel sauce, baked until golden. 
2. Main Courses: 
2.1) Grilled Swordfish: Flaky swordfish fillets grilled to perfection, served with a side of grilled asparagus. 
2.2) Lobster Bisque: Creamy lobster bisque with chunks of lobster meat, served in a ramekin. 
3. Side Dishes: 
3.1) Roasted Potatoes: Crispy roasted potatoes seasoned with thyme and garlic. 
3.2) Grilled Corn on the Cob: Sweet corn grilled until tender, served with a sprinkle of chili flakes. 
4. Desserts: 
4.1) Key Lime Pie: A classic key lime pie with a graham cracker crust. 
4.2) Coconut Sorbet: A light and refreshing coconut sorbet to balance the richness of the seafood. 
5. Drinks: 
5.1) White Wine: A crisp and refreshing white wine to pair with the seafood. 
5.2) Sparkling Water: A refreshing sparkling water to cleanse the palate.
